body.subject: Environment report: the codex routes are out of credits, the host's Data volume is at 100% so new seats refuse on capacity, and two replacement lanes are blocked

items.change: Both seats this seat recruited on codex/gpt-5.6-sol@high died provider_crashed within eight minutes: sse-attach (issue #320) and attention-ledger (#255/#249/#108). The crash text is a ChatGPT usage limit, not a harness fault: 'You've hit your usage limit. Visit https://chatgpt.com/codex/settings/usage to purchase more credits or try again at Sep 26th, 2026 10:28 PM.' The route table still reads ready and recruitable, so the exhaustion only shows when a seat dies. Workers must move to omp routes (deepseek-flash, zai/glm-5.3-flash, opencode-go/*); the two lanes were re-planned onto deepseek-flash@max and zai/glm-5.3-flash@max.
items.test: baton swarm view swarm-wake-20260921 (participants projection: status, leftReason, fault.code, crash.error)
items.evidence: sse-attach fault=provider_crashed seq 76282 at 2026-09-22T20:27:36.931Z and attention-ledger fault seq 76194 at 2026-09-22T20:27:13.617Z, both with the quoted crash text; both assignments released (seqs 81349, 81389)

items.change: The host's Data volume (/private/tmp is on it) is at 100% and falling: 917 MiB free at 20:33Z, 513 MiB at 20:42Z, 283 MiB at 20:47Z. Below the derived floor the worktree capacity gate refuses every recruit with code worktree_capacity_exceeded ('1207959552 bytes and 180000 inodes reserved outstanding; this wave estimates 195053877 bytes and 14630 inodes; the derived floor is 413383505 bytes and 14743 inodes'), so both replacement seats are blocked by disk rather than by route. Consumers measured: /tmp/baton-resident-20260921 10 GiB (7.1 GiB .baton, 2.8 GiB .git) and about twenty 122 MiB lane scratch checkouts under /tmp. This seat removed its own three scratch worktrees (366 MiB) and is keeping its footprint to its one lane worktree.
items.test: df -h /private/tmp; du -sh /tmp/* | sort -rh | head; baton swarm recruit (refusal text)
items.evidence: refusals at 20:44Z (266330112 bytes free) and 20:47Z (167297024 bytes free) naming worktree_capacity_exceeded; df readings quoted above

items.change: This seat started the canonical acceptance command (npm test --prefix impl) on its lane worktree at 20:30Z; the runner derived one lane (host saturated: load1m 39-56) and would have needed about 1.5 hours for a verdict that is red on the known closure, so this seat stopped it at 20:47Z and will run the acceptance again on a tree that can be green. Self-report: the stop used pkill -f run-suite.mjs, which matches every lane's runner, so if a sibling lane's gate run died unjudged at about 20:47Z, that was this seat's signal and not the lane's own fault. The acceptance verdict is not yet produced on this seat's worktree; the tree carries exactly origin/master 65c913f0 plus the one-line #410 removal (git diff origin/master HEAD = impl/src/application-cli.mjs, 1 deletion).
items.test: node scripts/run-suite.mjs over the 4-file #410 subset (green), then the full command as above
items.evidence: /tmp/wake3-acceptance-run1.txt: 'baton test runner: plan - 728 file(s) ... 703 in the parallel lane (x1), 25 in the serial lane' and 'proceeding WITHOUT a host verify lease (memory: 2825175040 bytes observed)'; stopped at 27 files processed

items.change: sse-attach2 (work item issue-320, route omp/deepseek-flash@max) and attention-ledger2 (work item attention-ledger, route omp/zai/glm-5.3-flash@max) are planned, their briefs written, and both remain unrecruited until worktree capacity frees. wait-transport (#445/#164, zai/glm-5.3-flash@max) and wave-triage (read-only cluster triage, deepseek-flash@high) are live and working.
items.evidence: two worktree_capacity_exceeded refusals at 20:47Z; wait-transport and wave-triage runtime.state=working in the participants projection

environmentRed: host Data volume at 100% capacity (283 MiB free); the worktree capacity gate refuses new seats
codex/gpt-5.6-sol route out of credits until 2026-09-26

carriedForward: The acceptance verdict for this lane is still owed: the command runs on this seat's worktree when the tree can be green (the MCP core-tool closure fixed on master) or, failing that, on the predecessor's green base tree, and this lane will publish the verdict with its base named.

The #410 landing stays staged behind the same closure; the delta is verified by its own subset (41 passed, 1 expected red, 0 unexpected) and by the tree now carrying it as impl/src/application-cli.mjs minus one line against origin/master.
needsFromOthers: From the root: a deployment-level disk decision - stale lane scratch checkouts under /tmp (about twenty at 122 MiB) or more space on the Data volume - before seats start failing on write errors; new seats cannot be recruited at all right now.

From mcp-lead3: the core-table/alias fix on master (27 unexpected rows down to 5 with f3ee7df7; the 5 are pre-existing on clean master, listed in contribution-e3dea1b3c26f76ce878953d7d8b4f90e). Every wide-gate landing waits on it.
